contenders.handicapper_notes: Best Bet standout at Tier 2 Illawarra Grange. Resumes 1st-Up off two recent barrier trials within 30 days (including 04-Nov at Rosehill), negating the first-up penalty, and won 1st-up last preparation over this exact 1400m track and trip. Holds dominant recent speed ratings (76 to 79, including Tier 1 metro BM68 placing on Heavy at Warwick Farm) and proven Soft form (5: 1-2-0). Maps for an ideal box-seat stalk from barrier 1 as a P-style runner with Leeshelle Small apprentice claim reducing effective weight from 60.8kg.

Hard-fit contender coming off a close 2nd in BM64 on Soft ground at Kembla Grange on 03-Nov (SR 71). Proven 1400m winner with two victories in his last five starts. Dropping back from 1600m to 1400m as a P-style stalker, he can sit outside the leader without excessive wide-draw penalty thanks to Illawarra Grange's 4% cambered bends, though 60.8kg without a claim brings a -3 pt top weight stamina tax.

Flagged as Danger Horse and Post-Scratch Lone Speed (+6 pts) as the sole E-style front-runner in the field from barrier 4. Third-up today after jumping sharply to SR 73 to lead throughout in a Newcastle Class 1 over 1300m. Handles Soft 5 (3: 1-0-1) and gets apprentice claim relief off 62.1kg, though still faces top weight tax rising to BM64 and is 0-for-3 at 1400m with ILG's 410m straight giving P and S types time to reel him in.

Resuming 1st-Up off two trials including a solid 3rd on Soft ground at Kembla Grange on 05-Nov. Experienced 1400m runner (21: 2-1-1) with proven Soft form (17: 2-4-2) and light 56.7kg weight avoiding stamina tax. As a C-style closer, ILG's 410m home straight and Soft 5 surface aid his late finish, though he must rebound from a 11.8L defeat before the spell.

Scratched from Race 5 to target this spot third-up, the same prep stage where he broke his maiden on Heavy ground last campaign (SR 70). Draws nicely in barrier 3 as an S-style runner and gets Soft 5 relief (+1 pt for S style), but recent speed ratings of 59 leave him well below the top trio and 58.1kg incurs a -2 pt weight tax.

First-Up from a four-month spell after ending last preparation beaten 27.9L over 2200m (SR 20). While she handles Soft tracks (5: 2-0-0) and carries a manageable 57.6kg from barrier 2 as an S-style runner, two quiet 7th-place trials suggest she will need further ground and fitness.
